moments.title: Welsh Derby Tonight: Cardiff vs Wrexham
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship season continues with a highly anticipated Welsh derby as Cardiff City host newly promoted Wrexham AFC tonight.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Derby Day! Cardiff City take on Wrexham AFC tonight at 8 PM in what's set to be a fiery Welsh Championship clash. Who are you backing?

angles.name: National Interest
angles.copy: It's an all-Wales affair in the Championship tonight! Cardiff City host Wrexham AFC, a fixture packed with history and rivalry. Kick-off is 8 PM.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's genre-hopping We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz, UK club culture, soul, hip hop, and electronica, takes over Wimborne St Giles, Dorset from Thursday.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is almost here! From Thursday, Dorset comes alive with jazz, hip hop, house, and electronica, all curated by Gilles Peterson. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Sold Out Buzz
angles.copy: It's SOLD OUT, but the buzz for We Out Here Festival is huge! Kicking off Thursday, it promises a incredible mix of sounds in Dorset. What's on your festival playlist?

moments.title: The Reytons Land Number 1 Album
moments.blurb: Sheffield indie rockers The Reytons have scored their latest UK Official Albums Chart #1 with 'A Love Letter to a Broken Town'.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Huge congrats to The Reytons! Their new album 'A Love Letter to a Broken Town' has shot straight to Number 1 on the Official Albums Chart. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Indie Success
angles.copy: Indie rock reigns supreme! The Reytons celebrate a massive week with their album hitting the top spot. What's your favourite track from the new record?

moments.title: Ariana Grande Continues London Residency
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' with more dates at The O2 Arena in London this week.

angles.name: Concert Excitement
angles.copy: London Arianators, get ready! Ariana Grande is back at The O2 this week for more dates on her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'. Who's heading to see her?

angles.name: London Buzz
angles.copy: The O2 is buzzing! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' continues its London run this week. If you're going, expect an incredible show!

moments.title: The Weeknd's Wembley Stadium Dates
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley Stadium for more massive shows this week.

angles.name: Stadium Show
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is set for another week of The Weeknd! His 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' continues, promising stunning visuals and huge hits. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Live Experience
angles.copy: Ready for an epic show? The Weeknd is back at Wembley Stadium this week, delivering his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to thousands of fans. Don't miss out if you're there!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Today marks the 68th birthday of iconic singer Belinda Carlisle, known for her incredible solo career and as the frontwoman of The Go-Go's.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Belinda Carlisle, turning 68 today! From The Go-Go's to her solo hits, what's your favourite song?

angles.name: Go-Go's & Solo
angles.copy: It's Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday! Celebrate with us by spinning a classic from her Go-Go's days or a solo smash like 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth'.

moments.title: Donnie Wahlberg Turns 57
moments.blurb: Happy 57th birthday to Donnie Wahlberg, singer, actor, and founding member of the legendary boy band New Kids on the Block.

angles.name: Boy Band Legend
angles.copy: Happy 57th birthday to New Kids on the Block's very own Donnie Wahlberg! What's your ultimate NKOTB track to celebrate with?

angles.name: Music & Acting
angles.copy: From dominating the charts with NKOTB to his acting career, we're wishing Donnie Wahlberg a very happy 57th birthday today!

moments.title: Scottish Schools Back After Summer
moments.blurb: Many pupils across Scotland, including in Glasgow, Dundee, and Edinburgh, returned to school last week, marking the end of the summer holidays for some.

angles.name: Back to Class
angles.copy: It's back to school for many across Scotland! Pupils returned to classrooms last week, signaling the end of summer fun for some. How quickly did your holidays fly by?

angles.name: Scottish Return
angles.copy: For our listeners in Scotland, the school bells rang again last week! Hope everyone had a great summer and is settling back into the routine.

moments.title: Liam Howlett of The Prodigy Turns 55
moments.blurb: Friday is the 55th birthday of Liam Howlett, the mastermind and producer behind groundbreaking electronic act The Prodigy.

angles.name: Dance Icon
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday on Friday to Liam Howlett, the genius behind The Prodigy! Which track gets you raving every time?

angles.name: Prodigy Power
angles.copy: From 'Firestarter' to 'Breathe', Liam Howlett has shaped electronic music. Wishing The Prodigy's producer a big 55th birthday this Friday!

moments.title: Kelis Celebrates 47th Birthday
moments.blurb: Friday is the 47th birthday of genre-bending R&B and soul singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There'.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Happy 47th birthday on Friday to the one and only Kelis! What's your go-to track from her iconic catalogue?

angles.name: Milkshake Moment
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to Kelis this Friday! Let's celebrate with 'Milkshake' and all her other amazing tunes.

moments.title: Dua Lipa Turns 31
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday, following a string of chart-topping hits and global success.

angles.name: Pop Sensation
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia indeed! Happy 31st birthday on Saturday to the incredible Dua Lipa. What's your favourite dancefloor filler from her?

angles.name: Birthday Grooves
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday. Spin your favourite track and join us in wishing her a fantastic day!

moments.title: Tori Amos is 63 on Saturday
moments.blurb: Influential alt-rock singer-songwriter and pianist Tori Amos celebrates her 63rd birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday on Saturday to the uniquely brilliant Tori Amos! Her groundbreaking music continues to inspire. What's your favourite album?

angles.name: Pianist & Songwriter
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 63rd birthday to the incredible Tori Amos this Saturday! Dive into her powerful discography with us.

moments.title: Julian Casablancas Turns 48

angles.name: Indie Rock Voice
angles.copy: Happy 48th birthday on Sunday to The Strokes frontman, Julian Casablancas! What's your favourite track from the indie icon?

angles.name: Strokes & Beyond
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 48th birthday to Julian Casablancas this Sunday! Celebrate with us by rocking out to The Strokes' classics.

moments.title: Happy 64th to Shaun Ryder

angles.name: Madchester Icon
angles.copy: Happy 64th birthday on Sunday to the one and only Shaun Ryder! Celebrate the Madchester legend with your favourite Happy Mondays or Black Grape track.

angles.name: Happy Mondays Vibes
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 64th birthday to the iconic Shaun Ryder this Sunday! Get into the groove with some Happy Mondays tunes.

moments.title: REWIND Festival South This Weekend
moments.blurb: The popular REWIND Festival South, known for its celebration of 80s music, takes place this weekend (Aug 21-23) in Henley-On-Thames.

angles.name: 80s Rewind
angles.copy: Dust off your shoulder pads! REWIND Festival South is back this weekend in Henley-On-Thames, bringing all the best 80s hits. Who's ready to party like it's 1986?

angles.name: Festival Weekend
angles.copy: It's a big festival weekend! REWIND Festival South kicks off in Henley-On-Thames this Friday. Expect a weekend of fantastic music and good vibes.

moments.title: Mild & Sunny Start to Week for UK
moments.blurb: The UK is set for a generally mild and sunny start to the week, particularly in the south, with temperatures in London reaching up to 27°C today before a slight cooling trend later in the week.

angles.name: Weather Update
angles.copy: Enjoy the sunshine! It's a mild and bright start to the week for much of the UK, with London seeing highs of 27°C today. Perfect for getting out and about!

angles.name: Summer Continues
angles.copy: Summer's still here! Expect pleasant temperatures and sunny spells across the UK this week, with a few showers possible towards the weekend.
